correctness.rationale: The marginal ratio laws and gamma moments at RESULT.md:22–46 are correct. In row-space coordinates G=[A;B], z=A†a and an orthonormal basis K of ker A give independent standard Gaussian Bz/||z|| and BK conditional on A, since z is orthogonal to K. The physical minimum projects Bz onto the orthogonal complement of range(BK), of dimension d−ℓ, while the raw rule keeps all d−r coordinates. The common scale is ||z||²/||a||², the inverse of a chi-square of dimension ℓ−r+1 by Schur complement; the numerator laws are independent of this scale. Integrating at zero gives the stated moment threshold. However, line 48 claims an improvement by a factor of expected nullspace squared error for all ℓ>r. For ℓ=r+1 both expectations are infinite, e.g. r=1, ℓ=2, d=3, so there is no such finite-factor reduction in expected error. The claim would require ℓ≥r+2; the samplewise ordering survives. When describing exact feasible corrections for individual sketches, G having full column rank is also not enough on its own: e.g. J=(1,0), G=(0,1)ᵀ makes JG zero. The full-row-rank property holds almost surely for the random sketch. The rational witness gives 7/2 versus 19/10 by minimizing z₁²+z₂² versus 1+9z₁²+z₂² subject to z₁+z₂=1. The supplied verification/check.py was inspected, not run; its reported 1,742 finite checks cannot validate moment divergence. No repair is delivered because correcting the finite-factor claim leaves the already covered comparison below.
